title: Auto-layout form draws a currency field with a stored expression as an editable input, and save silently replaces the typed value
body:
domain:devx#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTo666XXx9e1Gm21C6

Filing gate: an out-of-scope finding from card #27197 (showcase `invoice` goes multi-currency), found in the live run behind PR #31757 (os-dev-report 6731009088). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Problem

On the showcase `invoice`, `amount` is a currency field with a stored expression (it is computed on save). The auto-layout record form draws it as an ordinary editable input. A typed value is accepted, and the save replaces it without a word: `PATCH amount 999` answered 200, and the read back was `323.94`.

So the form offers an edit that can never take effect, and the user is not told.

## Ask (for the ui seat to shape)

A field whose value the server computes on save should render read-only on the auto-layout form (and, likely, on inline edit), the same way other computed fields do. Decide whether the server should also refuse a client-written value for such a field instead of overwriting it in silence.

## Reader

`domain:ui`, from triage. #27197 lands without this.

Related: #27197, #31743 (child currency follow, the other finding of the same run).
